title: get_measures input
description: The nine default measures and the ten slide-back signals (playbook chapters 17 and 19), computed from the records the product keeps over equal windows that end today, each with the rows behind it. A read for any role. Targets and thresholds come from the measure-targets and signal-thresholds settings (configuration rows), and each signal lists the decisions it led to.

windows.description: How many windows, the newest ending today.

measureKey.description: List the rows behind this measure.

signalNumber.description: List the rows behind this signal.
